svg.aria-label: Frame time and fixed updates per frame across a full-turn yaw sweep at one million entities, through the cardinals against half a step off them
svg.text: An unpinned sweep measures a camera jump; pinned, a crossing costs one frame
IRPerfGrid, 1,000,000 entities, Release, stage profiling off, 300 frames at 1.2° a frame. Both sweeps run 0° to 358.8° through the cardinals.
Pivot pinned at the grid centre
Default pivot, which re-latches on a settled frame
Fixed updates run inside the frame (the loop clamps at 8)
Camera yaw of the rendered frame
602 ms: the pivot re-latches on the 90° frame and the view jumps
